name: laptop-integrated-16gb
deviceClass: Windows laptop, Intel Iris Xe integrated GPU, 16 GB RAM
source: Core i7-1255U class (10 cores, 12 threads, Iris Xe 96 EU), 15.6 inch 1920x1080 at 100 percent scaling. Chrome caps deviceMemory at 8, so 16 GB reports the same value as 8 GB. GPU limits are the WebGPU specification default limits (the floor every adapter must meet), not a measurement of this device. What an Iris Xe laptop really reports for maxBufferSize was not measured. User agent follows the shape current Chrome sends (reduced UA); the version number is illustrative.
